mapper.insert: insert ignore into favorite (user_id, dish_id, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{dishId}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from favorite where user_id = #{userId} and dish_id = #{dishId}
mapper.select: select d.id dishId, d.name dishName, d.price, d.image, d.status, n.calorie, s.name stallName from favorite f join dish d on f.dish_id = d.id left join nutrition n on n.dish_id = d.id left join stall s on s.id = d.stall_id where f.user_id = #{userId} order by f.id desc
